from pathlib import Path
prog = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0 and all(x == grid[r][c] for x in grid[r]) and all(grid[y][c] == grid[r][c] for y in range(h)))
    rowcuts = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    colcuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rbounds = [-1] + rowcuts + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + colcuts + [w]
    rtiles = [(rbounds[i] + 1, rbounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(rbounds) - 1)]
    ctiles = [(cbounds[i] + 1, cbounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cbounds) - 1)]
    th, tw = rtiles[0][1] - rtiles[0][0], ctiles[0][1] - ctiles[0][0]
    colors = [next((grid[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] for dr in range(th) for dc in range(tw) if grid[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] not in (0, sep)), 0) for r0, _ in rtiles for c0, _ in [ctiles[0]]]
    mask = None
    for r0, r1 in rtiles:
        for c0, c1 in ctiles[1:]:
            cells = {(r - r0, c - c0) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] not in (0, sep)}
            if cells:
                mask = cells
                break
        if mask:
            break
    out = [[sep if r in rowcuts or c in colcuts else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    for ir, (r0, r1) in enumerate(rtiles):
        for c0, c1 in ctiles:
            for dr, dc in mask:
                out[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] = colors[ir]
    return out
'''
path=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u042/system/state/workspace/programs/task-8544a157.py')
